payload.reason: The evidence provides specific evaluation criteria and metrics used for assessing the generated text, including edit distance, word error rate, and manual evaluation methods.

claims.text: The evaluation includes measuring the edit distance between generated text and its corrected variant, indicating the effort needed for corrections.
The word error rate (WER) of the generated text compared to its corrected variant is reported as 5.6%.
Gold standard event selection is used to evaluate the generated text at the event level by comparing it to existing reference texts.
A minimum edit evaluation is performed, correcting only factual mistakes and grammatical errors.
